summary: Vesta Real Estate Corporation filed a Form 6-K containing its Q1 2026 earnings press release and unaudited interim financial statements. The filing reports routine quarterly results including rental income of $76.7M, Adjusted NOI margin of 95.1%, and leasing activity of 1.6 million sf. It also notes a $118M prepayment of secured debt and a $74.8M dividend approved at the annual shareholders' meeting. No merger, acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or other special-situation transaction is disclosed. This is a standard earnings report of a foreign private issuer, equivalent to a routine Form 10-Q or earnings press release in the US.
